Ravi — thanks for the clear ask and the template. I've attached an "Acceptance & Evidence Matrix" that maps LuminarSoft's items to Redwood artifacts. High-level notes: 

1) SOC 2: We can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report and the associated system description. If you need a bridge letter for events after the report period we can provide that as well.
2) SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a CAIQ-style mapping (see redwood-soc2-sig-summary.pdf). For items where we rely on cloud provider controls we list the compensating controls and provide the vendor attestations.
3) DPA & retention: Our standard DPA contains 90/180/365 day retention profiles configurable per customer. For LuminarSoft's PII/financial use case we recommend the 90-day hot/365-day cold default. We are open to narrow edits to data residency clauses but will need a mutually agreed SOW for private deployment or VPC options.

Next steps I propose: 
- Review the attached matrix and mark must-have vs nice-to-have items by 2027-05-24.
- Redwood will deliver SOC2 + CAIQ mapping within 48 hours after you flag must-haves.
- Align on DPA edits in parallel; our legal can accept redlines for non-standard clauses.

I've copied Karthik (sec eng) and Ben (AE) for technical and commercial follow-up.

Attachments: Acceptance_Evidence_Matrix_LuminarSoft.xlsx, redwood-soc2-sig-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Mina Haddad

Subject: RE: technical notes on evidence matrix and retention

Hi Ravi / team — following up on Mina's matrix with a few technical clarifications that help lock the acceptance criteria: 

- Encryption & keys: We encrypt data at rest with AES-256 and use customer-managed keys (KMS) for Dedicated & Private deployments. For Hosted API, we offer KMS integration for tokens and sensitive keys; we can provide an HSM attestation for on-prem placements.
- KV/cache: We purge KV caches per-tenant on deprovision; standard retention applies to persisted logs only.
- Data flows: We'll provide a redacted architecture diagram showing where PII touches our runtime and where we rely on cloud provider logging (included in the CAIQ mapping).
- Evidence delivery: SOC2 and CAIQ mapping will be delivered as PDFs; technical artifacts (architecture diagram, config snippets) as separate attachments or Drive links.

On retention windows — if LuminarSoft requires <90 day retention for certain datasets we can accommodate via Dedicated or Private deployment with configuration at onboarding. For Hosted, 90/365 is our baseline.

I'll be available for a 30-min technical call to walk the security team through the matrix on 2027-05-26 or 05-27. Proposed slot: 2027-05-26 15:00 PT.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
